ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, the line $y = -\frac{1}{2}x + 2$ intersects the x-axis at point B and the y-axis at point C. A parabola with the axis of symmetry $x = \frac{3}{2}$ passes through points B and C and intersects the negative half of the x-axis at point A. Let M be a moving point on the parabola, and N be on the line $BC$. When the quadrilateral formed by points O, C, M, and N is a parallelogram, directly write down the coordinates of point N.

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：图中有直角坐标系，O 在坐标轴交点处；一条向右下方倾斜的直线经过 y 轴上的 C 点和 x 轴正半轴上的 B 点；一条开口向下的抛物线也经过 C、B 两点，并在 x 轴负半轴与 A 点相交；图中还画出一条竖直直线表示抛物线的对称轴，位置在 y 轴右侧。推理：由直线 y=-1/2 x+2 可得与 x 轴交点 B=(4,0)，与 y 轴交点 C=(0,2)。抛物线对称轴为 x=3/2，设抛物线为 y=a(x-3/2)^2+k。代入 C=(0,2)、B=(4,0)，得 a=-1/2，所以抛物线为 P: y=-1/2 x^2+3/2 x+2。设 N=(t,-1/2 t+2) 在直线 BC 上。考虑 O,C,M,N 四点构成平行四边形时的三种对顶点配对关系。第一种 N=M-C，则 N 的轨迹为 y_N=y_M-2=-1/2t^2+3/2t。与直线 BC 相交：-1/2t^2+3/2t=-1/2t+2，得 t=2，所以 N=(2,1)。第二种 N=C-M，则 N=(-x_M,2-y_M)，轨迹为 y_N=2-f(-t)=1/2t^2+3/2t。与直线 BC 相交：1/2t^2+3/2t=-1/2t+2，得 t=-2±2√2。代入 y=-1/2t+2，得 N=(-2-2√2,3+√2)、(-2+2√2,3-√2)。第三种 N=M+C，则轨迹为 y_N=y_M+2=-1/2t^2+3/2t+4。与直线 BC 相交：-1/2t^2+3/2t+4=-1/2t+2，得 t=2±2√2。代入 y=-1/2t+2，得 N=(2+2√2,1-√2)、(2-2√2,1+√2)。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the diagram, the line $y=-\frac{1}{2}x+2$ intersects the x-axis at point $B$ and the y-axis at point $C$. A parabola with axis of symmetry $x=\frac{3}{2}$ passes through points $B$ and $C$ and intersects the negative half of the x-axis at point $A$. Let $M$ be a moving point on the parabola, and let $N$ be on line $BC$. When quadrilateral $OCMN$ is a parallelogram, directly write down the coordinates of point $N$.
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there is a rectangular coordinate system, O is at the origin, C is on the positive y-axis, B is on the positive x-axis, and A is on the negative x-axis; line BC slopes downward to the right; the parabola opens downward, passes through C and B, and has a vertical axis of symmetry x=3/2. Reasoning: From the line y=-1/2 x+2, get B=(4,0), C=(0,2). Set the parabola as y=ax^2+bx+2, and the axis of symmetry is x=3/2, so -b/(2a)=3/2, namely b=-3a. Substitute B=(4,0): 16a+4b+2=0, giving a=-1/2, b=3/2, so the parabola is y=-1/2 x^2+3/2 x+2. Set N=(t,-t/2+2). Because it only says quadrilateral OCMN is a parallelogram, discuss according to three possible pairings of opposite vertices. First type: O and M are opposite vertices, C and N are opposite vertices, then M=C+N=(t,-t/2+4). Substitute into the parabola to get t=2, so N=(2,1). Second type: O and C are opposite vertices, M and N are opposite vertices, then M=C-N=(-t,t/2). Substitute into the parabola to get t=-2±2√2, so N=(-2-2√2,3+√2), (-2+2√2,3-√2). Third type: O and N are opposite vertices, C and M are opposite vertices, then M=N-C=(t,-t/2). Substitute into the parabola to get t=2±2√2, so N=(2+2√2,1-√2), (2-2√2,1+√2).
